E-103 WATER SIDE: TSV-103 RECOMMENDED IF IT CAN BE BLOCKED IN (SAFETY-LAYERS TAB, NOT DRAWN)

X = ACTION ON TRIP. SETTINGS FROM K.trip*; DELAYS FROM sisStep [5, 5, 10, 5, 5] s; ACTIONS FROM sisTrip.
REFLUX DRUM LEVEL LOW-LOW (BPCS, NOT A SIF)
N₂ VACUUM BREAK HV-110 WITH POT > 150 °C
PERMISSIVES TO ARM HEATING (armPermissives, ALL REQUIRED): VP-101 RUNNING AND PIC-102 < 250 mbar · P-108 RUNNING AND FI-108 ≥ 0.6 m³/h · LI-101 > 30 % ·
P-101 RUNNING · TIC-107 < 320 °C · HV-110 CLOSED. ARMING OPENS XV-101 AND ENABLES HE-101. OPERATOR DISARM: XV-101 CLOSED, HE-101 OFF.
VP-101, P-108, P-101 AND P-104 KEEP RUNNING ON A SIS TRIP: VACUUM, CONDENSER AND REFLUX STAY ON SO THE COLUMN COOLS UNDER TOTAL REFLUX.
CONTROL VALVE, DIAPHRAGM; FO / FC = FAIL OPEN / CLOSED
PV PROCESS VAPOUR · PL PROCESS LIQUID · VG VACUUM GAS
NG NITROGEN · HO HOT OIL · TW TEMPERED WATER · CW COOLING WATER
PSV-101 C-101 TOP · RD-102 + PSV-102 POT (PID-001)
TSV-101 HOT-OIL SIDE OF D-102 → TK-102 (PID-002)
TK-102 HOT-OIL EXPANSION TANK, N₂ BLANKET (PID-002)
OWN SENSORS FOR PSHH-102, LSLL-101, FSLL-108
SOURCE: HAZOP R02/R03/R13 AND SAFETY-LAYERS REGISTER
1. PART OF THE ALTERNATIVE VERSION (EPC STANDARD). GENERAL NOTES, EQUIPMENT LIST AND PROCESS SIDE: VBD-PID-001.
2. HOT OIL: SUPPLY 290 °C (TIC-107), RETURN 255.6 °C (ΔT 34.4 K). TV-101 36.7 % OPEN GIVES mcp 0.087 kW/K = 125 kg/h AT cp 2.5 kJ/kg K (ASSUMED);
TV-101 WIDE OPEN ≈ 1080 kg/h. HE-101 4.04 kW = POT DUTY 3.00 kW + LOOP LOSS 1.04 kW (BALANCE CLOSES TO 0.000 kW).
3. OIL GRADE, FLASH POINT, LOOP VOLUME, P-101 HEAD, HE-101 ELEMENT STEPS: TBC. HE-101 HAS POWER ONLY WITH P-101 RUNNING (MODEL; CONFIRM).
4. JIC-101 DUTY = FT-101 × cp × (TT-107 − TT-108). FT-101 IS A NEW TAG FOR THE FLOW THE MODEL USES; METER TYPE AND RANGE TBC.
5. TEMPERED WATER 60 °C, 1.2 m³/h; ΔT ACROSS E-103 1.7 K AT 2.37 kW. KEEP SUPPLY ABOVE 45 °C (TI-109 L ALARM): ESTERS FREEZE AT 30–38 °C.
6. E-104 / HV-104 ONLY FOR COOL-DOWN (SHUTDOWN PROCEDURE). COOLING-WATER CONDITIONS TBC.
7. DCS ALARMS (OTS): TIC-107 H 315 °C · JIC-101 H 5.0 kW · FI-108 L 0.6 m³/h · TI-109 L 45 / H 80 °C · TIC-101 H 280 °C.
8. LINE SIZES PRELIMINARY (TBC): HOT OIL DN25 = 0.72 m/s AT 1080 kg/h (ρ 750 ASSUMED); TEMPERED WATER DN25 = 0.60 m/s.
9. A TRIP SETS JIC-101 AND TIC-107 TO MAN 0 % (TV-101 SHUT, HE-101 OFF), TIC-101 TO MAN, XV-107 TO CLOSED; SIS-100 LEAVES RUN SO XV-101 CLOSES.
10. PSHH-102, FSLL-108 AND LSLL-101 ACT ONLY WHILE HEATING IS ARMED. TSHH-101 AND TSHH-107 ACT ALWAYS AND BLOCK THE RESET WHILE ABOVE THE SETTING.
11. SIS-100 DE-ENERGISES TO TRIP; XV-101 AND TV-101 FAIL CLOSED; HE-101 CONTACTOR OPENS. FIRST-OUT SHOWN ON THE SIS FACEPLATE.
12. SHARED SENSORS (SAFETY-LAYERS TAB GAPS): PT-102, FT-108, LT-101 SERVE CONTROL / ALARM AND TRIP. OWN SENSORS ARE RECOMMENDED (HOLD).
13. AIR INGRESS (HIGH RISK IN THE HAZOP) HAS NO SIF: TZ-110 AND AN O₂ ANALYSER AT-102 ARE RECOMMENDED (HOLD).
14. SIL TARGETS, PROOF TESTS AND RESPONSE TIMES: SRS OF SIF TAB. CAUSE AND EFFECT: C&E MATRIX VBD-IN-CE-001.
SHEET 2 OF 2 · HOT-OIL SKID, TEMPERED WATER, SIS-100, INTERLOCK SCHEDULE
